definition: Primary diagnosis DIAG_PRINC three-character prefix; N20, N21, N22, N23 are the broad N20–N23 outcome. K80, K81 and K85 are separate diagnosis groups.
limits: Counts are hospitalization admissions summed to 450 health-region-days, not unique persons.

definition: Clinical aggregate restricted to IDENT=1; CAR_INT=02 urgent and CAR_INT=01 elective. Broad N20–N23 and strict N20 are reported separately.
limits: Urgent/elective are admission categories; procedure codes are not used to infer them.

definition: Principal diagnosis AFECPRIN prefix N20–N23 for broad outcome; prefix N20 for strict outcome; eligible geographic code is ENTIDAD 1–32.
limits: Municipality exposure branch is a subset of the valid-state admission cohort.

definition: Not available as a field in the retained Mexico admission/procedure caches; no urgent/elective classification is inferred from procedures.
limits: A separate Mexico admission-type description is unavailable in this cache.

definition: The legacy K80 age cache uses 0–14, 15–44, 45–64 and 65+ groups. A separate targeted source audit aggregates DATASUS COD_IDADE/IDADE and SEXO by year and diagnosis.
limits: The legacy age cache is K80-specific and has no sex field; source-level age/sex counts are in the joint/marginal tables and demographic_summary_table.csv. SEXO values remain source codes.

period: Broad severity aggregates: source 2008–2023, reported 2008–2022; strict urgent N20 model: 2018–2022
definition: The broad daily builder counts death when MORTE=1 and ICU when UTI_MES_TO>0. The separate strict urgent N20 model requires DIAG_PRINC prefix N20 and CAR_INT=02; n20_severe is ICU (UTI_MES_TO>0 or UTI_INT_TO>0) or death (MORTE=1). It compares heat-only, smoke-only and both days with neither in conditional Poisson models with health-region×year-month×weekday strata and CRV1 health-region clustering.
source_or_field: build_daily_severity.py; build_beddays.py; build_n20_severe.py; fit_n20_severe.py; MORTE; UTI_MES_TO; UTI_INT_TO; CAR_INT
limits: The strict urgent N20 severe result has 4,967 outcome events and 20,463 retained model area-day rows; model n is not a case count. Broad aggregate and strict-N20 ICU definitions are different and remain separately labelled.

definition: Principal diagnosis prefixes H25/H26 for cataract and S02, S12, S22, S32, S42, S52, S62, S72, S82 and S92 for fracture. Outcome-specific conditional Poisson models use same-day tmean per 1°C and fire PM2.5 per 10 μg/m³ jointly, with health-region×year-month×weekday strata and CRV1 health-region clustering; no lag terms.
limits: The 335,928 cataract and 2,356,578 fracture values are retained model area-day rows, not admission counts. Fracture may be heat-sensitive and is not a clean negative control; a null cataract estimate does not prove absence of confounding.

definition: AFECPRIN prefixes H25/H26 for cataract; S02, S12, S22, S32, S42, S52, S62, S72, S82 and S92 for fracture; valid states ENTIDAD 1–32.
limits: State-day aggregates; no individual rows exported.

definition: Per-health-region tmean P90 and fire PM2.5 P75 estimated in the 2008–2020 baseline; heat and smoke use strict greater-than; both means heat=1 and smoke=1.
limits: Four descriptive groups are neither, heat only, smoke only and both; composite is the both indicator.

definition: RH and humidex are merged by health_region_2023 and local_date from land-weighted contribution columns; the helper merges precomputed weighted contributions.
limits: The current descriptive pass does not rebuild the upstream grid contribution weights.

definition: ERA5-Land hourly 2 m temperature converted K to °C, averaged by day, then cos(latitude)-weighted over grid points within state polygons; 32 states × 1,826 days. NASA POWER at state-capital coordinates is a distinct secondary product.
limits: This state-level method is distinct from the municipality exposure-complete branch.

definition: State-specific tmean P90 and fire PM2.5 P75, each estimated through 2020; strict greater-than thresholds; both is heat=1 and smoke=1.
limits: Municipality panel categories are summarized separately from the 32-state model panel.

definition: Admission is climate-complete when its municipality-date has nonmissing tmean, fire PM2.5, heat and smoke; RH-complete is separately tabulated.
limits: 1,098 exclusions are decomposed by invalid state versus valid-state missing exposure in sample_flow_summary.csv.

definition: Monthly SUS beds from CNES LT, summed to 450 health regions; supply is SUS beds / panel population × 100,000. Fixed low/mid/high groups use the 2018 region-level mean tertiles.
limits: Area-level supply proxy is not local hospital capacity or occupancy.

definition: Full-window area-day inputs and lag-0–7 complete inputs are separate. All-zero fixed-effect strata and one-observation strata are separate: the former are reported in acute_repair_model_summary.csv; the complete calendar has no one-observation base stratum (minimum 4 rows full-window, 3 after lag restriction).
limits: Rows dropped by a fit are never relabelled as singleton strata.

domain: Brazil source age and sex audit
definition: Filtered RD aggregates use DIAG_PRINC, DT_INTER, MUNIC_RES, SEXO, COD_IDADE and IDADE. COD_IDADE=2/3 sub-year units are grouped under 0–14; code 4 uses IDADE in years; code 5 is grouped under 65+; code 0 is retained as unknown. Age and sex are grouped by year and diagnosis.
source_or_field: aggregate_case_demographics.py; DATASUS RD fields SEXO, COD_IDADE, IDADE
limits: SEXO 1=male, 3=female; aggregate counts reconcile to annual diagnosis totals; no identifiers exported.

domain: Mexico source age and sex audit
definition: Source-file vintage mapping: 2018 legacy units; 2019 code4/5 months/years and legacy code1/2; 2020–2022 modern units code2=hours, code3=days, code4=months, code5=years. The mixed 2019 source code3 EDAD15–29 cannot distinguish years from days and remains explicitly ambiguous. Code3 EDAD1–14 belongs in 0–14 under either unit; EDAD30–120 can only be valid years. All mappings follow source-file year, not admission year. EDAD999, inconsistent values and undocumented codes remain unknown; validation bounds hours1–23, days1–29, months1–11, years1–120.
source_or_field: Source fields EDAD/CVEEDAD; legacy SAEH v2.2 and modern 2020 GIIS v3.7; source-year counts retained
limits: Mexico age units were interpreted by source-file vintage, not admission year, using legacy SAEH and the modern TIPO_EDAD catalogue. For 2019 code 3, EDAD 15–29 remains explicitly ambiguous (years versus days); no age band was imputed. EDAD 1–14 gives the same 0–14 band under either unit; values 30–120 cannot be valid days. The age profile therefore includes an explicit ambiguity category. The 33 source-expanded admissions are outside this baseline demographic table. Brazilian SEXO codes are 1=male and 3=female; Mexican codes are 1=male, 2=female, 9=unspecified. These are admission counts, not unique persons.
